title_sq: Ne Fresk, Shitet Dyqan Ideal Per Investim!!

title_en: In Fresk, ideal store for investment for sale!!
description_en: In Fresk, ideal store for investment for sale!! The shop is located on the 0th floor of a new building, on the edge of Muhamet Deliu street, and is organized in a single open space environment and a toilet. The store has glass facades on both sides, giving a very good advertising opportunity to the business that will be developed. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
